استحممت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَمْتُ (istaḥmamtu) /is.taħ.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
# اِسْتَحْمَمْتَ (istaḥmamta) /is.taħ.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
# اِسْتَحْمَمْتِ (istaḥmamti) /is.taħ.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
